_doc: Per-story config for the visual QA (scripts/qa-story-data.mjs -> qa-story.json -> scripts/visual_qa.py). Frames here are STORY frames (storyboard.json). See docs/VISUAL_QA.md.
_subjectGeometry: world-space box around the subject's anchor point (DIRECTOR_SUBJECTS[name].at): metres below / above the anchor and half width; OR screenW/screenH = a box of that fraction of the frame width around the projected anchor (fx cards drawn at constant screen size, cast.ts scr()). Approximate: findings that depend on it are warn-level.
_extraSubjects: subjects that are not DIRECTOR_SUBJECTS: a function exported by story.ts, called with the shot's event clock ('clock') or the story frame ('frame')
